mapper.select: select sdc.id, sdc.user_id, sdc.card_user_id, sdc.seat_id, sdc.consumption_date, sdc.status, sdc.check_in_time, sdc.create_time, ss.seat_num, sr.room_name, sc.card_title from sr_day_card_consumption sdc left join sr_seat ss on ss.seat_id = sdc.seat_id left join sr_room sr on sr.room_id = ss.room_id left join sr_card_user scu on scu.id = sdc.card_user_id left join sr_card sc on sc.id = scu.card_id where sdc.user_id = #{userId} and (sdc.del_flag is null or sdc.del_flag = '0') order by sdc.consumption_date desc, sdc.create_time desc
